newsitem.title: USA: Imagyn given FDA notice on falloposcopes.
newsitem.headline: Imagyn given FDA notice on falloposcopes.

text.p: Imagyn Medical Inc said Tuesday it received formal notice from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for a 501(k) premarket notification review of falloposcopes used to evaluate proximal tubal occlusion in the fallopian tube.
The FDA had previously told the company that the process had to be reviewed by the more rigorous premarket approval application process.

Under the terms of the new 501(k) policy, the FDA will permit clearance based upon a showing of substantial equivalence to selective salpingography catheters and hysteroscopes, with clinical data to support use of falloposcopy devices.
Shares of Imagyn were 1/2 higher at 10-7/8 in midday trading on Nasdaq.
